brief: Interpret future resources separately from spending needs and inspect contribution, ownership and projection assumptions.

title.es-MX: Lee un plan para el futuro
title.pt-BR: Leia um plano para o futuro

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Retirement Planning"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lee un plan para el futuro"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leia um plano para o futuro"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Interpret future resources separately from spending needs and inspect contribution, ownership and projection assumptions.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Use fictional dollars to distinguish projected resources, spending needs and plan conditions.
instruction.misconception: A large projected balance proves coverage regardless of spending, eligibility, fees or ownership conditions.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use the current visible conditions; do not reuse a previous scenario’s answer.

evidence.reasoning: The balance must be compared with the needs it supports.
The sources can differ in eligibility, ownership and access.
The unmet condition limits the stated employer ownership.
Earlier participation includes an additional contribution period.
Recurring costs reduce the money carried into later periods.
Purpose, amount and date make the goal specific.
Changed spending needs can alter coverage with the same balance.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
